prompt: This rustic bar interior features dark wooden plank floors, paneled walls, and an exposed beam ceiling, with a deep red accent wall at the far end. On the left, round wooden tables with chairs are arranged, one displaying a green cloth and bottles, beneath framed artwork and a mounted animal head. A long, dark wooden bar counter with stools occupies the right, backed by shelves stocked with bottles, all bathed in a warm, inviting glow from pendant lights and a table lamp.
